Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. profession (n)
/prəˈfeʃn/
nghề nghiệp chuyên môn (đòi hỏi đào tạo bài bản như y khoa, luật, giảng dạy)
Collocation: the medical profession, enter a profession
"Teaching is a respected profession that requires both patience and academic dedication."
2. qualification (n)
/ˌkwɒlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/
bằng cấp, chứng chỉ chuyên môn
Collocation: academic qualification, professional qualification
"Applicants need a university qualification in computer science to apply for this position."
3. candidate (n)
/ˈkændɪdət/
ứng viên xin việc (hoặc thí sinh dự thi)
Collocation: ideal candidate, interview a candidate
"The company interviewed five promising candidates for the marketing manager role."
4. recruit (v)
/rɪˈkruːt/
tuyển dụng nhân sự mới
Collocation: recruit skilled staff, recruit new graduates
"Many technology firms recruit talented graduates directly from top universities."
5. colleague (n)
/ˈkɒliːɡ/
đồng nghiệp cùng cơ quan/công ty
Collocation: senior colleague, supportive colleague
"Discussing ideas with experienced colleagues helps young employees learn much faster."
6. promotion (n)
/prəˈməʊʃn/
sự thăng chức, thăng tiến trong công việc
Collocation: earn a promotion, career promotion
"After three years of hard work, she received a well-deserved promotion to team leader."
7. remuneration (n)
/rɪˌmjuːnəˈreɪʃn/
tiền lương, thù lao và đãi ngộ tài chính (từ C1 thay cho salary/pay)
Collocation: generous remuneration, fair remuneration package
"High-stress professions often offer generous remuneration to attract qualified specialists."
8. flexible (adj)
/ˈfleksəbl/
linh hoạt (về giờ giấc hoặc địa điểm làm việc)
Collocation: flexible working hours, flexible schedule
"Flexible working hours allow parents to balance their career and family responsibilities."
9. productivity (n)
/ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti/
năng suất lao động, hiệu suất làm việc
Collocation: boost productivity, workplace productivity
"A quiet workspace and short breaks can significantly increase employee productivity."
10. overtime (n/adv)
/ˈəʊvətaɪm/
giờ làm thêm, làm tăng ca ngoài giờ hành chính
Collocation: work overtime, unpaid overtime
"Working excessive overtime every week can damage both physical health and family harmony."
11. workload (n)
/ˈwɜːkləʊd/
khối lượng công việc phải đảm nhận
Collocation: heavy workload, manage a workload
"Digital automation tools help office workers manage a heavy workload more efficiently."
12. burnout (n)
/ˈbɜːnaʊt/
tình trạng kiệt sức về thể chất và tinh thần do áp lực công việc kéo dài
Collocation: suffer from burnout, prevent employee burnout
"Employees who never take holidays are at high risk of suffering from severe burnout."
13. freelance (adj/adv)
/ˈfriːlɑːns/
làm nghề tự do (nhận dự án độc lập, không biên chế cố định một công ty)
Collocation: freelance designer, work freelance
"Many graphic designers choose to work freelance so they can travel and choose their own clients."
14. satisfaction (n)
/ˌsætɪsˈfækʃn/
sự hài lòng, thỏa mãn trong công việc
Collocation: job satisfaction, sense of satisfaction
"For many teachers, helping students succeed brings greater job satisfaction than money."
15. ambition (n)
/æmˈbɪʃn/
hoài bão, khát vọng vươn lên trong sự nghiệp
Collocation: career ambition, achieve one's ambition
"Her lifelong ambition is to establish an eco-friendly architecture firm in Hanoi."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Xác Định: Who, Which, That, Where, Whose)

• who / that (Thay cho danh từ chỉ người):
  Ví dụ: Employers prefer candidates who possess strong communication skills and practical qualifications.

• which / that (Thay cho danh từ chỉ sự vật, công việc, chính sách):
  Ví dụ: Remote work is a modern arrangement which allows employees to have a flexible schedule.

• where (Thay cho nơi chốn / môi trường làm việc = in which):
  Ví dụ: Young professionals thrive in companies where hard work is rewarded with fair promotion.

• whose + Noun (Chỉ sự sở hữu của người hoặc vật):
  Ví dụ: Workers whose workload is excessively heavy often suffer from burnout.

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Không Xác Định & Which Thay Cho Cả Mệnh Đề)

• Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (Có dấu phẩy , who / , which): Bổ sung thông tin cho danh từ đã xác định; tuyệt đối không dùng that sau dấu phẩy.
  Ví dụ: Remote employment, which became widespread after 2020, reduces daily commuting stress.

• Cấu trúc , which + V (số ít) (Thay cho toàn bộ mệnh đề đứng trước — Chiêu thức GRA Band 7.0+):
  Ví dụ: Many employees are forced to work unpaid overtime, which inevitably leads to mental burnout and lower productivity.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Nursing is a demanding ________ that requires both medical knowledge and deep empathy.
2. Having a postgraduate ________ and fluent English gives job seekers a strong advantage.
3. Out of thirty applicants, she was the only ________ who passed all three interview rounds.
4. Growing hospitals need to ________ more qualified doctors and nurses to serve rural communities.
5. Whenever I face a technical problem at the office, my supportive ________ are always ready to help.
6. Consistently exceeding sales targets helped him earn a rapid ________ to regional director.
7. Top international law firms offer attractive ________ packages to retain their best lawyers.
8. Many software engineers appreciate ________ working hours because they can avoid rush-hour traffic.
9. Studies show that a four-day workweek can maintain or even boost overall ________.
10. Staff members who regularly work late ________ on weekends often feel exhausted on Monday mornings.
11. Hiring two new assistants helped reduce the team's excessive ________ during the busy season.
12. Chronic workplace stress and lack of rest can lead to emotional ________ and depression.
13. Instead of signing a full-time contract, he works as a ________ translator for several publishers.
14. A respectful workplace culture and meaningful tasks contribute to high job ________.
15. Young graduates with strong ________ are eager to learn new skills and take on leadership roles.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 6] Working parents must balance their career ambitions with their family ________.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 7] Several old factories were converted into modern office ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 8] Working from home twice a week reduces daily ________ time on crowded highways.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 9] Ecotourism creates sustainable employment for ________ communities in mountain areas.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 10] Museum curators need specialized training to ________ historical manuscripts.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Companies prefer to recruit candidates ________ possess both academic qualifications and teamwork skills.
2. Employees ________ workload is constantly excessive are much more likely to suffer from burnout.
3. Many young people want to work in an environment ________ creativity and innovation are encouraged.
4. Remote working, ________ has become popular worldwide, allows staff to enjoy a flexible schedule.
5. Many office workers have to work unpaid overtime every evening, ________ negatively affects their family life.
6. A freelance career is an attractive option ________ gives creative professionals greater independence.
7. Mentors ________ guide junior colleagues patiently play a vital role in workplace training.
8. High remuneration alone cannot guarantee job satisfaction in a company ________ employees feel disrespected.
9. The software engineer ________ designed our new cybersecurity system received an immediate promotion.
10. Companies ________ invest in employee wellbeing experience higher productivity and lower staff turnover.
Điểm: 0/10

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - New Expectations in Modern Professions]
Over the last decade, the nature of employment has transformed across almost every profession. In the past, companies that wanted to recruit top graduates focused mainly on formal academic qualifications. While a strong candidate still needs technical expertise, modern workers also value a healthy work-life balance. Instead of pursuing only high remuneration and rapid promotion, many young professionals prioritize long-term job satisfaction and personal wellbeing.

[Paragraph B - The Rise of Flexible and Freelance Work]
Advances in cloud technology have allowed millions of office staff to adopt flexible working hours or pursue freelance careers from home. Research indicates that employees who can control their daily schedule often achieve higher productivity because they do not waste two hours commuting in heavy traffic. However, remote workers sometimes miss the daily social interaction with supportive colleagues, which helps build teamwork and creative ambition.

[Paragraph C - Managing Workload and Preventing Burnout]
A major challenge of digital work is that smartphones blur the boundary between the office and home. Employees whose workload is poorly managed frequently check emails late at night and work unpaid overtime. Psychologists warn that continuous pressure without adequate rest inevitably leads to mental burnout. Therefore, progressive organizations now encourage staff to disconnect after working hours.
Điểm: 0/6
